purpose: Clean-sheet passive and fixed-income alternatives for an independent macro-first portfolio assessment.

scope.parent_responsibility: Independently set the current macro risk budget and compare core active managers; these are candidate instruments, not an approved portfolio.
scope.method: Official manager product pages, a public manager status feed, official legal documents and an official ETF creation/redemption basket. Browser skill was read, but browser/delegation tools were unavailable. No login, order submission or account verification.
scope.source_query_count_note: Seven discovery searches; additional direct official-page/document/API reads and read-only HTTP inspections were used. Not all source requests are counted as searches.

old_pool_check.use_of_registry: Membership check only; no old rankings, exclusions, portfolio weights or manager judgments were adopted.

fee_convention.unit: Percent per year unless explicitly a transaction charge.
notes: NAV already reflects accrued fund expenses; do not deduct the quoted annual fee a second time from reported NAV returns.
Management/custody sums exclude transaction costs, taxes, other fund expenses, broker commissions and bid-ask spreads.

A feeder's displayed management/custody rates are not proof of its effective whole-NAV fee base. Target-ETF fee-base exemptions and look-through expenses were not separately verified; do not blindly add feeder and ETF headline rates.
No discounted subscription fee, brokerage rate or premium is assumed.

parent_handoff.recommended_shortlist: 110020 for domestic equity beta; 511010 for a separately budgeted government-duration sleeve; 513500 only as a conditional overseas comparator.
parent_handoff.one_fund_case: 110020 can implement the authorized China-equity sleeve alone, but is not by itself a risk-balanced household portfolio.
parent_handoff.multi_fund_case: A domestic-equity plus government-duration construction is a candidate structure, not a fixed allocation. Add US equity only after its independent risk budget and execution gates pass.
parent_handoff.cash_treatment: Cash needed for spending, settlement or optionality must remain separately identified. Neither 511010 nor 511360 is automatically cash; no 75% cash rule.
